text:
My filling fell out...so I asked my sister who recommended this place. I usually get it done here. I tried searching for reviews on Gmap and it was okay, but there were some complaints about the price. I called to check and made an appointment. I got there at 3:00 PM on time. I couldn't find the entrance, so I called Starbucks to ask. Parking is also paid. I haven't been here in a while, but the stamp at the clinic is free. There's a hotel...so confusing. I came at night, but during the day it's different. I filled out my information and waited for the car for about 5 minutes. The guy probably does everything. So I went in and saw the doctor. At first glance, he was so handsome!
...so embarrassed...the doctor talked to me and I didn't feel scared because I don't usually get dentists. He was very gentle. He finished quickly, didn't take long, and made me want to fall asleep on the bed. 😂He didn't even give me any toothpaste.😎 I give him a 4❤️❤️❤️❤️, deducting 1.

restaurant_name: ด๊อกเตอร์เจน คลินิกทันตกรรม
text: The place is clean, comfortable, and the equipment is considered good. The dentist is lovely and polite. Today I went in for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). I called to check the price beforehand...the answer was 600 baht for upper and lower teeth for the standard method. However, I have dental implants, so I informed the dentist. Therefore, they had to change to airflow tartar removal instead to protect the implants. I would like to suggest that the dentist should inform the customer of the price before the procedure for the convenience of the customer and to avoid any inconvenience later, because the standard price is 600 baht, but the airflow method is 2500 baht (upper and lower), which is a significant price difference. Overall, it was good, not painful, and I didn't experience any tooth sensitivity. But if you can accept the higher price, then it's okay.
